session_provenance.launch_configuration: All actor/reviewer sessions launched with fork_turns=none; no model override.
session_provenance.model_configuration: Inherited parent default; provider/version not surfaced by collaboration tool.
session_provenance.actor_note_capture: Controller transcription of final responses; Markdown/path presentation normalized; factual claims remain self-reports.
notes: Early six reveals predate provisional-hash recording; phase order retained in timestamps and session sequencing.
One attempt per scenario; reviewers share the same default model family; no statistical or cross-model generalization.

archive_notes: Paths normalized for portability; original fingerprints refer to original run bytes, not normalized replay inputs.
Actor notes are self-reports; their capture method must be recorded by the controller.
AMH command output is captured; arbitrary actor shell/read/edit events are not fully audited.
Actor/reviewer access restrictions are instructional on a shared filesystem, not an OS sandbox.
A missing pre-reveal hash is retained as null, not reconstructed after review.
